user.title: GoodWe Time-of-Use
user.description: Connect to the GoodWe Wi-Fi/LAN dongle that talks to the inverter.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the inverter. Check the host, port and that the dongle is online.

set_cheapest_hours.name: Set cheapest hours
set_cheapest_hours.description: Plan the four Time-of-Use windows from the price forecast: charge in the cheapest hours and discharge in the most expensive ones.

set_windows.name: Set windows
set_windows.description: Write an explicit list of Time-of-Use windows to the inverter (start, stop, signed power and days).
